mentions.description: A predictive AI tool in beta that helps businesses spot issues heading their way before they hit. It is being run as a company in its own right and is seeking waitlist joins and people willing to test it.
mentions.problem: After launching and running a first startup that reached £7m GMV pa in 2 years and still failed, the founder wondered whether the signs of struggle could have been spotted earlier and built the tool that would have helped then.
mentions.audience: businesses wanting to spot issues heading their way before they hit
